overall_goal: Add butter, cheese, and torn parsley to the risotto, and chop the remaining parsley

goals.description: Set up the digital scales and a bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bowl and digital scales, placing the bowl on the scales to prepare for weighing ingredients.
The person gets a knife and butter, cuts the butter, and places it into the bowl on the scales.

goals.description: Retrieve parsley from the fridge and get a bowl
goals.rationale: The person searches the fridge for parsley, retrieves a packet, and gets another small bowl from the cupboard.

goals.description: Tear parsley leaves into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person tears the parsley into smaller pieces and drops them into the bowl.

goals.description: Finely chop the rest of the parsley
goals.rationale: The person prepares the chopping board and uses a knife to finely chop the remaining parsley.

goals.description: Transfer the chopped parsley into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person gathers the chopped parsley and transfers it into a small bowl.

goals.description: Add cheese and butter to the risotto and stir
goals.rationale: The person adds the grated cheese and butter to the frying pan and stirs the ingredients together.
